_comment: Expected output of `sw decompose spec.md` for the todo-cli spec. Exact text may vary across runs but the milestone count and rough scope should match.

milestones.name: storage-layer
milestones.description: Implement atomic JSON storage at ~/.todo/store.json with 0600 perms.

milestones.name: add-and-list
milestones.description: todo add and todo list (with --all) commands. Deterministic output format.

milestones.name: done-and-rm
milestones.description: todo done <id> and todo rm <id>. Exit 1 on unknown id.

milestones.name: coverage-and-polish
milestones.description: Reach ≥90% coverage on todo/. Hit edge cases (empty store, corrupted JSON).
